User.title: User Profile
User.description: Information about Pitchcell users, including their tier (Free vs Premium).

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

isPremium.description: Whether the user has upgraded to Premium for unlimited generations.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

DailyUsage.title: Daily Usage Tracking
DailyUsage.description: Tracks the daily generation count for free-tier users to enforce the limit of 5 daily generations.

userId.description: Refers to the owner of this usage record.

date.description: The current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

count.description: Number of generations made on this day.

Opportunity.title: Startup Opportunity
Opportunity.description: Structured startup opportunity analysis generated by the AI.

inputPrompt.description: The raw inputs/thoughts entered by the user.

targetUsers.description: A list of target user segments.

features.description: Core features generated for this opportunity.

feasibilityScore.description: A startup feasibility rating from 1 to 10.

opportunities.description: Unexplored expansion opportunities and market dynamics.

skepticFeedback.description: Constructive but harsh 'AI Skeptic' feedback on why the startup might fail.

isSaved.description: Whether the user flagged this opportunity as saved.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when this opportunity was created.

users/{userId}/dailyUsage/{dateId}.description: Tracks daily generation counts for limiting free users to 5 of them.
